edge.title: Baseline: Muon (lr 0.02, wd 0.01) + aux AdamW, WSD, 3600 steps
edge.summary: Root script (train_gpt_simple.py). All 72 hidden 2-D block weights (q, k, v, attn.proj, mlp.fc, mlp.proj) use Muon: an EMA momentum (mu=0.95) with a Nesterov blend, 12 Newton–Schulz iterations of a convergent quintic (2, −1.5, 0.5) toward the polar factor, sqrt(max(1, rows/cols)) scaling, and decoupled decay p *= 1 − lr·wd (lr=0.02, wd=0.01). The token embedding, untied LM head and all 1-D params (RMSNorm gains, biases) use AdamW; every group follows a flat-then-linear-to-zero schedule over the last 70% of 3600 steps, and every parameter named 'proj' (including the LM head) starts at zero.

changes.label: Muon on hidden block matrices
changes.detail: muon_update: momentum.lerp_(grad, 1-mu), Nesterov blend grad.lerp_(momentum, mu), orthogonalize, scale by max(1, rows/cols)**0.5 (2x for mlp.fc). Muon.step does p.mul_(1 - lr*wd) then p.add_(update, alpha=-lr); matrices are size-sorted, sharded round-robin over ranks and all_gather'ed.

changes.label: Convergent Newton–Schulz, 12 iters
changes.detail: zeropower_via_newtonschulz5 casts to bf16, divides by the Frobenius norm (+1e-7) and runs 12 steps of X <- 2X - 1.5(XXᵀ)X + 0.5(XXᵀ)²X, a quintic with fixed point 1 and zero slope there (accuracy-oriented, not the speedrun's speed-tuned coefficients).

changes.label: Aux AdamW for embed/head/1-D
changes.detail: optimizer1 = AdamW groups: embed.weight lr=0.3, LM head proj.weight lr=1/320, every ndim<2 param (RMSNorm gains and all biases) lr=0.01; betas=(0.8, 0.95), eps=1e-10, weight_decay=0, fused=True.

changes.label: Stable-then-linear-decay LR
changes.detail: set_hparams(step, cooldown_frac=0.7): eta=1 while step/train_steps < 0.3, then eta=(1-progress)/0.7 down to 0; multiplies every group's initial_lr in both optimizers. No warmup; Muon momentum is constant.

changes.label: Zero-init of every 'proj' param
changes.detail: Any parameter whose name contains 'proj' is zeroed: attn.proj and mlp.proj weights/biases and the untied LM head (model.proj) weight/bias. All others keep PyTorch defaults (Linear weights and biases U(±1/sqrt(fan_in)), embedding N(0,1), gains 1).

changes.label: Fixed benchmark harness
changes.detail: GPT-2-small: 12 layers, d=768, 6 heads x 128, QK RMSNorm, half-truncated RoPE, ReLU² MLP, biased Linears, bf16 embedding, logit soft-cap 15. Batch 8x64x1024 tokens, loss reduction='sum' with SUM all-reduce; val on 20x524288 tokens every 125 steps.

edge.parent_check: Root record (no parent). The logged script is identical to records/track_3_optimization/train_gpt_simple.py at git b011285 (2026-04-26).

techniques.note: lr 0.02, wd 0.01, mu 0.95 Nesterov, NS 12 iters (2,-1.5,0.5); all 72 block 2-D weights
AdamW embed 0.3 / head 1/320 / 1-D 0.01, betas (0.8,0.95), eps 1e-10, wd 0
flat for first 30%, then linear to 0 (cooldown_frac 0.7), same eta for all groups
attn.proj, mlp.proj and LM head (model.proj): weights and biases zeroed

hparams.init.hidden_std: torch default nn.Linear U(±1/sqrt(fan_in)), std ≈ 0.0208 (q, k, v, mlp.fc)
hparams.init.proj: zero (attn.proj, mlp.proj and LM head weights)
hparams.init.bias: torch default U(±1/sqrt(fan_in)) for q/k/v/fc; proj biases zero

mechanisms.name: Muon
mechanisms.explain: Each hidden matrix keeps an EMA of its gradient (mu=0.95) and forms the Nesterov blend (1−mu)·g + mu·m. Twelve Newton–Schulz iterations push all singular values of that matrix toward 1 (≈UVᵀ of its SVD), so every direction moves by the same amount regardless of gradient magnitude. The result is scaled by sqrt(max(1, rows/cols)) and applied with the scheduled lr after decoupled decay p *= 1 − lr·wd.

mechanisms.name: Auxiliary AdamW
mechanisms.explain: Parameters that are not hidden 2-D matrices (token embedding, untied LM head, RMSNorm gains, all biases) use torch AdamW with per-group learning rates 0.3 / 1/320 / 0.01, betas (0.8, 0.95), eps 1e-10 and no weight decay. Because the loss is summed over all 524288 tokens, gradients are large and eps=1e-10 is negligible, so the updates are effectively scale-free.

mechanisms.name: Stable-then-linear-decay (WSD) LR
mechanisms.explain: set_hparams multiplies every group's initial lr by eta = 1 while step/train_steps < 0.3, then by (1 − progress)/0.7, reaching 0 at train_steps. Because Muon's decay is p *= 1 − lr·wd with the scheduled lr, weight decay is annealed together with the step size.

mechanisms.name: Zero-initialized projections
mechanisms.explain: Attention and MLP output projections start at zero, so every residual block is initially the identity map; the untied LM head is also zero, so initial predictions are uniform (logged step-0 val loss 10.826 = ln 50304). The blocks grow their contributions from the first Muon steps.

caveats: Evidence is a single run (3.2777, n=1) recorded before the significance rule existed; (3.28 − 3.2777)·√1 < 0.004, so it would not pass the current test. Loss uses reduction='sum' and gradients are SUM-all-reduced; Muon (Frobenius-normalized NS) and Adam (eps=1e-10) are insensitive to that scale.
